Files: vision_bundle.mjs, vision_wasm_internal.js, vision_wasm_internal.wasm (stored gzipped).

selfie_segmenter_landscape.tflite: the MediaPipe selfie segmentation (landscape) model from npm
@mediapipe/selfie_segmentation 0.1.1675465747 (Apache License 2.0), with TFLite image segmenter
metadata added (input normalization mean 0, std 255; one label "person") by tflite-support's
metadata writer, so MediaPipe Tasks ImageSegmenter can load it.
